title: Grateful Dead Live at Field House, University of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03
lineage: Used Diamond Cut/Forensics 8.1 to clean up the monitor noise (sounds like an unshielded cable) and a little of the over saturation (analog recorder clipping) on the source

ai_review.summary: Excellent‑sounding soundboard recording of the 1970 show that listeners rave about, even though specific musical details are scarce.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers gave five stars and repeatedly say the recording “sounds great” and that they love it.  The file is a .sbd (soundboard) capture that has been concatenated into three set files, but no listener mentions any audio flaws or performance problems, indicating a clean, enjoyable listening experience despite the lack of detailed musical commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Uniform 5‑star ratings and enthusiastic language point to a highly regarded show and recording; however, reviewers provide no concrete musical analysis, so the rating reflects strong listener satisfaction but limited detail.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the sound as great with no reported issues; the recording has been concatenated into three set files, suggesting a clean, well‑balanced capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on song order or pacing; reviewers only note overall enjoyment of the performance.
